Thanks for the response. strace seems like a good idea and will report back next week, out of town for the weekend.

pytorch doesn't seem to work with conda for this configuration

I am having a similar issue, currently trying to use PyTorch on the newly-released Jetson Xavier:
```python
import torch
print(torch.cuda.is_available())
t = torch.tensor([1., 2.], device='cuda')
```
Prints `True` before hanging (It's been close to 10mins).

@haudren it looks like it's JIT-compiling kernels, which is weird. You must've compiled from source right (because ARM)? Did you run out of disk-space by any chance?

@soumith : Thanks for this advice. It seems to have resolved when I rebuilt it using `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH="7.2+PTX"`. I'm not sure what was the issue, either pytorch does not yet build for 7.2 yet by default or I ran out of space somehow.
